```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(flextable)

tar_load(comparison_data)
tar_load(original_data)
```

p-values
```{r}
print("Core - Positive")
sum(comparison_data$Core.Positive >= original_data$Core.Positive, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000

print("Core - Negative")
sum(comparison_data$Core.Negative >= original_data$Core.Negative, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000

print("Core - NA")
sum(comparison_data$Core.NA>= original_data$Core.NA, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000

print("Supernumerary - Postive")
sum(comparison_data$Supernumerary.Positive>= original_data$Supernumerary.Positive, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000

print("Supernumerary - Negative")
sum(comparison_data$Supernumerary.Negative >= original_data$Supernumerary.Negative, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000

print("Supernumerary - NA")
sum(comparison_data$Supernumerary.NA >= original_data$Supernumerary.NA, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000
```
